From maintaining devices

01 / BEFORE AND AFTER

12 areas.
One change of model.

Compare how you work when each gateway is maintained separately with how you work with a fleet managed by IoT Gateway NG + Edge Manager.

AREAS WITH CENTRALISED MANAGEMENT0 / 12

Without the platform: installed devices that you must maintain one by one.

  1. 01✕✓

    Commissioning

    Without: Manual installation and configuration of each device.

    With: Automated, repeatable installation and configuration.

  2. 02✕✓

    Deployment time

    Without: Each new installation takes hours of preparation.

    With: New devices prepared with a standard configuration.

  3. 03✕✓

    Remote maintenance

    Without: Site visits or manual connections to resolve incidents.

    With: Centralised monitoring and maintenance, with fewer on-site interventions.

  4. 04✕✓

    Cybersecurity

    Without: Irregular or forgotten security updates.

    With: Controlled updates of the system and the installed components.

  5. 05✕✓

    Application management

    Without: Installing and updating applications device by device.

    With: Deploy and update applications remotely on multiple devices.

  6. 06✕✓

    Monitoring

    Without: Hard to know the status of the gateways.

    With: Centralised visibility of device status, health and incidents.

  7. 07✕✓

    Failure recovery

    Without: Reconfiguring replacement devices by hand.

    With: Faster configuration recovery and device replacement.

  8. 08✕✓

    Standardisation

    Without: Each installation can end up with different configurations.

    With: Consistent, documented and reproducible configurations.

  9. 09✕✓

    Vendor independence

    Without: Dependence on specific hardware or a specific ecosystem.

    With: Freedom to choose compatible hardware and applications.

  10. 10✕✓

    Scalability

    Without: Maintenance cost grows almost as fast as the number of devices.

    With: Centralised management of tens or hundreds of devices.

  11. 11✕✓

    Incident diagnosis

    Without: You must connect to each device to investigate a problem.

    With: Centralised information to detect and diagnose failures.

  12. 12✕✓

    Total cost of ownership

    Without: More technician hours, site visits and repetitive tasks.

    With: Less operational effort and more predictable maintenance costs.

These benefits are potential: they depend on the features actually deployed, the available connectivity and the compatibility of the devices and applications.
